create_draft.description: Save an email to the Drafts folder without sending it, so someone can check it and send it from their mail app or webmail. Give it an email to reply to and the draft is a reply that threads with that email once it is sent.
create_draft.name: create_draft

parameters.description: Who it will go to, separated by commas. Can be left for whoever sends it; a reply left blank goes to the original's sender.
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: The subject line. A reply left blank reuses the original's subject with 'Re:' in front.
parameters.name: subject

parameters.description: The message, as plain text.
parameters.name: body

parameters.description: Optional formatted version of the message, as HTML. Mail apps that can show it do; the plain text body is kept for the rest.
parameters.name: html_body

parameters.description: Addresses to copy in, separated by commas.
parameters.name: cc

parameters.description: Addresses to copy in without the others seeing, separated by commas.
parameters.name: bcc

parameters.description: Files to attach. Upload a file or reference a document (or list of documents) from an earlier step.
parameters.name: attachments

parameters.description: The ID of an email to draft a reply to - the 'id' that 'List emails', 'Move an email' or the 'New email' trigger returns. Leave blank for a new email.
parameters.name: reply_to_email_id

parameters.description: The folder the email being replied to is in. Leave blank for the inbox.
parameters.name: reply_to_folder

parameters.description: When replying, include the original email below the draft.
parameters.name: include_original

create_folder.description: Create a folder, optionally inside another one. If it already exists nothing changes, so a workflow can run this every time.
create_folder.name: create_folder

parameters.description: The new folder's name, such as Invoices.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: The folder to create it in. Leave blank for the top level.
parameters.name: parent

delete_email.description: Move an email to Trash, where it can still be recovered, or turn on 'Delete permanently' to remove it for good. An email already in Trash is always removed for good.
delete_email.name: delete_email

parameters.description: The email's ID in its folder - the 'id' that 'List emails' or the 'New email' trigger returns.
parameters.name: email_id

parameters.description: The folder the email is in. Leave blank for the inbox.
parameters.name: folder

parameters.description: Remove the email for good instead of moving it to Trash.
parameters.name: permanently

download_attachment.description: Save an email's attachments to Lodol's document storage, so a later step can use them - attach them to another email, read an invoice, and so on. Name one to download just that, or leave it blank for all of them (up to 20). An email attached whole comes down as an .eml file.
download_attachment.name: download_attachment

parameters.description: The email's ID in its folder - the 'id' that 'List emails' or the 'New email' trigger returns.
parameters.name: email_id

parameters.description: The folder the email is in. Leave blank for the inbox.
parameters.name: folder

parameters.description: The attachment to download, as 'Get an email' lists it. Leave blank for all of them.
parameters.name: filename

flag_email.description: Flag an email, the way a person does in their mail app, so it stands out as needing attention. The flag stays on the email when it is moved, shows in every mail app, and anyone can clear it there. 'List emails' can return flagged emails only.
flag_email.name: flag_email

parameters.description: The email's ID in its folder - the 'id' that 'List emails' or the 'New email' trigger returns.
parameters.name: email_id

parameters.description: The folder the email is in. Leave blank for the inbox.
parameters.name: folder

forward_email.description: Forward an email with a note of your own. By default the original is quoted in the message with its attachments re-attached; turn on 'Forward as attachment' to attach the whole original email instead, exactly as it arrived.
forward_email.name: forward_email

parameters.description: The email's ID in its folder - the 'id' that 'List emails' or the 'New email' trigger returns.
parameters.name: email_id

parameters.description: The folder the email is in. Leave blank for the inbox.
parameters.name: folder

parameters.description: Who to send to. Separate several addresses with commas; a name is allowed, as in Jane Doe <jane@example.com>.
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: A message to put above the forwarded email.
parameters.name: body

parameters.description: Addresses to copy in, separated by commas.
parameters.name: cc

parameters.description: Addresses to copy in without the others seeing, separated by commas.
parameters.name: bcc

parameters.description: Attach the original email whole (.eml) instead of quoting it.
parameters.name: as_attachment

parameters.description: Re-attach the original's attachments when quoting it. On unless you turn it off.
parameters.name: include_attachments

parameters.description: Keep a copy in the Sent folder, as a mail app would, and return its ID there as 'sent_id'. On unless you turn it off.
parameters.name: save_to_sent

get_email.description: One email in full: its text, its HTML, who it was from and to, and a list of its attachments. Reading it does not mark it as read.

mock_response.body:
Hi Jane,

Please find invoice 1042 attached.

Thanks,
Accounts
mock_response.reply_body:
Hi Jane,

Please find invoice 1042 attached.

Thanks,
Accounts
mock_response.snippet: Hi Jane, please find invoice 1042 attached.
mock_response.subject: Invoice 1042

get_email.name: get_email

parameters.description: The email's ID in its folder - the 'id' that 'List emails' or the 'New email' trigger returns.
parameters.name: email_id

parameters.description: The folder the email is in. Leave blank for the inbox.
parameters.name: folder

list_emails.description: The newest emails in a folder, newest first, with their text. Filter by sender, subject, date, unread only or flagged only. Reading them does not mark them as read. Each email's text is read from its first 64 KB, which covers almost every message; 'Get an email' reads one in full.

emails.body:
Hi Jane,

Please find invoice 1042 attached.

Thanks,
Accounts
emails.reply_body:
Hi Jane,

Please find invoice 1042 attached.

Thanks,
Accounts
emails.snippet: Hi Jane, please find invoice 1042 attached.
emails.subject: Invoice 1042

list_emails.name: list_emails

parameters.description: The folder the email is in. Leave blank for the inbox.
parameters.name: folder

parameters.description: Only emails nobody has read yet.
parameters.name: unread_only

parameters.description: Only emails that carry a flag, whether a person or 'Flag an email' put it there.
parameters.name: flagged_only

parameters.description: Only emails whose sender contains this, such as accounts@supplier.example or supplier.example.
parameters.name: from_address

parameters.description: Only emails whose subject contains this text.
parameters.name: subject_contains

parameters.description: Only emails received on or after this date.
parameters.name: since

parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Read each email's text. Turn off for a faster list of senders and subjects only.
parameters.name: include_body

list_folders.description: Every folder in the mailbox, with the ones used for sent mail, deleted mail, drafts and spam picked out, and the mailbox's own address.

parameters.description: The email's ID in its folder - the 'id' that 'List emails' or the 'New email' trigger returns.
parameters.name: email_id

parameters.description: The folder the email is in. Leave blank for the inbox.
parameters.name: folder

mark_as_unread.description: Mark an email as unread, for example so it stands out for a person to deal with.
mark_as_unread.name: mark_as_unread

parameters.description: The email's ID in its folder - the 'id' that 'List emails' or the 'New email' trigger returns.

parameters.description: The message, as plain text.

parameters.name: html_body

parameters.description: Also reply to everyone the email was sent or copied to.

parameters.description: Addresses to copy in, separated by commas.

parameters.description: Addresses to copy in without the others seeing, separated by commas.

parameters.description: Files to attach. Upload a file or reference a document (or list of documents) from an earlier step.
parameters.name: attachments

send_email.description: Send an email from the connected Rackspace mailbox, with attachments if you like, and keep a copy in its Sent folder. Rackspace allows each address 10,000 recipients a day, counted from midnight US Eastern time. If Rackspace refuses some of the recipients but not all, the email goes to the rest and 'refused_recipients' lists who did not get it.
